thread:
elaine-sales: Heads-up team — CareLoop asking for a 2-week POC. Requirements: Private/VPC deployment in us-west-2, a small Dedicated GPU pool (~100 rps), ephemeral hosted API keys for an internal demo, audit log forwarding to their Splunk + S3 retention 12 months, KMS BYOK for wrapping, and completed security questionnaire. Any blockers?

jordan-se: Quick clarifying questions: Do they need full VPC peering (private endpoints) or just egress rules to our ingestion endpoints? Any strict data residency beyond US?

elaine-sales: US-only (us-west-2). They want no internet-facing inference endpoints for the POC — full peering preferred.

alex-platform: We can stand up a Private deployment in us-west-2. For ~100 rps with short inputs I'd provision 4 equivalent units (A10G-class) as dedicated pool (autoscale disabled for predictability). For the ephemeral demo we can issue hosted tokens scoped to demo routes with TTL and token caps.

alex-platform: Needed customer network info for infra ticket:
```
CUSTOMER_VPC_CIDR=10.2.0.0/16
CUSTOMER_PEER_VPC_ID=vpc-0abcd1234
REDWOOD_PRIVATE_SUBNET=172.31.128.0/20
```

alex-platform: Audit/export: we support Splunk HEC + S3 archival. We can also redact prompt text on export. Example Splunk HEC config we request from customers:
```
{
  "hec_endpoint": "https://splunk.careloop.internal:8088/services/collector",
  "hec_token": "<customer-provided>",
  "format": "json_event",
  "fields": ["request_id","model","latency_ms","route"],
  "retention_days": 365
}
```

marco-security: On KMS: we support customer-managed CMKs. For BYOK we need the KMS ARN and a key policy that grants Redwood the decrypt/wrap permission (or cross-account role). Also confirm whether prompts may contain PHI/PII; if so we need to enable redaction and additional logging controls.

marco-security: I'll start filling sections of the security questionnaire (infra, auth, data flows). @elaine-sales please attach their questionnaire PDF. We typically need ~48 hours to assemble evidence (screenshots, config snippets, sample audit CSV).

elaine-sales: Sending questionnaire and Splunk details to marco via DM now.

sam-legal: Note: CareLoop will require a short-term DPA and a SOW for the dedicated pool trial. I can draft a 14-day DPA + limited SOW. Need their billing entity and POC contact.

elaine-sales: POC contact: katie@careloop.ai; billing entity: CareLoop Inc.

jordan-se: Ballpark POC pricing and fees:
- Dedicated pool (4-unit equivalent): ~$3,500/week (dev trial discount applied)
- One-time Private deployment & network/KMS/Splunk hooking: ~$1,200 engineering setup fee
- Ephemeral hosted keys for demo: no extra fee, scoped and timeboxed
Keep autoscale off unless they request it (would increase burn).

elaine-sales: Can we issue ephemeral hosted keys while private endpoints are being provisioned? They want to demo to internal PMs first.

alex-platform: Yes. We can create ephemeral hosted API keys scoped to demo routes with token limits (e.g., 10k tokens/day) and automatic TTL-based revoke. All requests still flow through hosted infra and are logged.

sre-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4872 — CareLoop Private POC (us-west-2). Items: 4-unit dedicated pool, VPC peering, Splunk HEC streaming, S3 archive 365d, KMS BYOK. ETA: ~72 hours after ticket approval.

marco-security: Add to checklist: admin action logs, key rotation evidence, sample exported audit CSV for SOC review. We will redact content columns by default for exported POC artifacts unless customer signs off to include raw prompts.

elaine-sales: Next steps: jordan will formalize quote and discount; alex to confirm network/setup ETA in ticket; marco to begin questionnaire responses; sam to send DPA + SOW. I'll update CareLoop with timelines.

jordan-se: Will circulate the official quote today and include the one-time setup fee and dev discount.

alex-platform: Confirmed ETA: ~72 hours after SOW signed and ticket approved. I'll add the step-by-step rollout and rollback plan to INFRA-4872.

sam-legal: I'll draft and share the DPA + 14-day SOW by EOD. Need to confirm contact for signing.

elaine-sales: Thanks all :rocket: looping in @katie-careloop on next message to set expectations.

sre-bot: INFRA-4872 status: in-progress (assigned to @alex-platform).
